ProjectWeave request for the selected Task (data): {"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABehD4rQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhICHP8", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 295, "title": "Simplify Graph Library details: show only Required models without accordion", "body": "## Goal Simplify the expanded graph detail area in **Graph Library**. Keep **Required models** as the *only* model/metadata information displayed, without an accordion. Remove the other informational and cache-diagnostic UI elements. This is a focused **UI cleanup**, not a redesign of model preparation, graph execution, or the separate Models page. ## Current implementation In `extension/graph-library.html`, the selected graph's `#selected` detail region ends with: ```html
Models & saved information

Updated
Required models
File cache

File cache checks do not load models. ... Manage model files

``` `extension/graph-library-page.js` populates these fields in `renderSelectedState()` and implements `#check-cache` inspection, states, and invalidation hooks. ## Required change 1. Remove the entire `Models & saved information` accordion / `
` container and its toggle behavior. 2. **Keep only `Required models`**, displayed **always**, directly at the **bottom of the expanded graph detail panel** (below the Name/Description editing form and its save-status area). There must be no extra click or expansion needed to view it. - Use a compact, accessible label/value presentation; retain the visible label **Required models**. - Preserve the existing derived value from `models(entry)` rather than introducing new model detection: - Show the same list of model names for valid model-bearing graphs. - Continue showing `None` for a valid graph with no required models. - Continue showing the existing `Unknown · repair graph first` fallback for invalid graphs. - Continue to reflect changes when the selected graph changes or the library is refreshed (including subgraph resolution where applicable). 3. **Remove**, rather than relocate, these graph-detail UI elements: - `Updated` / `#graph-updated` - `File cache` / `#graph-cache` - `Check model files` / `#check-cache` - `#cache-hint` - The file-cache/Live explanation and the `Manage model files` link within the accordion 4. Remove code, imports, event handlers, listeners, state and CSS that exist **only** to support the removed graph-detail cache check/status and accordion. Do not leave hidden/disconnected controls or dead code. - Look in `extension/graph-library-page.js` for `state()`, `states`, `#check-cache` handler, `ModelAssetCache` usage, and cache-update/focus listeners. Remove only if now unused. - Review `extension/graph-library.css` for `#graph-metadata` styling; replace with minimal styling for the remaining always-visible model field if needed. - **Do not remove or break** `models(entry)`, `graphModelRequirements`, or the model-name derivation: the graph list's search filter also uses `models(entry)`. 5. Keep the global `Models` navigation link in the page header. Do not change the dedicated Models page, model file preparation/caching mechanisms, graph storage formats, graph editing, or Live execution. 6. **Out of scope:** deciding whether/where the removed **Check model files** diagnostic will reappear. We will discuss that separately later; do not reimplement or relocate it as part of this task. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] Opening a graph in Graph Library shows **Required models** at the very bottom of its detail area, immediately, with no collapsible section. - [ ] No `Models & saved information` disclosure remains, and none of the removed fields/buttons/links/explanatory text are rendered in the selected graph details. - [ ] Model lists still render correctly for model-bearing and model-free graphs; invalid graphs retain their existing recovery fallback. - [ ] Switching graphs, library changes, and ordinary Name/Description autosave still work. - [ ] Model-name based search continues working; the header's `Models` link still works. - [ ] Layout is legible at desktop and narrow/mobile extension widths; label/value semantics remain accessible. - [ ] No obsolete event handlers, state, unused imports, or CSS selectors from this feature remain. - [ ] Tests are updated and pass; no graph data, runtime behavior, or cache files are changed by this cleanup. ## Tests / verification Update `tests/extension/graph-library.spec.js`. It currently references `#graph-metadata`, `#graph-cache`, `#check-cache`, and `#graph-models` (including the `detailAction(..., 'check-cache')` helper). Replace assertions for the deleted UI with assertions for the always-visible **Required models** field and the absence of the removed controls. Retain unrelated graph detail, autosave, duplication, validation/recovery, and interaction coverage. Also review `tests/extension/layout.spec.js` and `tests/browser/extension-layout.spec.js` for any layout dependencies, and adjust only as necessary. Run relevant automated checks and report the commands/results in the implementing PR. ## Relevant code - [Graph Library markup](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/graph-library.html) - [Graph Library page logic](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/graph-library-page.js) - [Graph Library CSS](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/graph-library.css) - [Graph Library UI tests](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/tests/extension/graph-library.spec.js) ", "url": "https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/295", "created_at": "2026-11-12T04:35:22Z", "state": "OPEN", "repository": "takahirox/my-audio-to-text", "labels": ["task"], "priority": null, "status": "In Progress", "is_archived": false}, "context": {}, "resources": {}, "allocation": {}, "instruction": null, "run_id": "c6a54ca5b51748b1a5d194997131c7a0"}
